structuredContent.name: tenants.get-tenant
structuredContent.description: Read one tenant's full details: name, description, status (Active or Disabled), creation time, members with their roles, and configuration settings. The caller must be a member of the tenant or a global administrator. A missing tenant is reported as not found to a global administrator and as forbidden to anyone else. It is not paged: all members are returned and the pageSize, offset and cursor arguments are not used; to page a long member list, use tenants.get-tenant-users.

TenantId.description: Identifier of the tenant to read. Required; a call without it is rejected.
